expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Transforms a parent-space vector to local space with inverse rotation and scale. @param V Direction or displacement in parent space. Inverse-rotates a parent-space vector without scale or translation. @param V Direction or displacement in parent space. Converts a local-space rotation to parent space. @param Q Rotation in this transform's local space. Converts a parent-space rotation to this transform's local space. @param Q Rotation in the parent space. Returns this translation minus B's translation. Normalizes the rotation quaternion in place. Compares translation components within Tolerance. Returns the rotation component as a rotator. Post-multiplies the rotation by DeltaRotation. Parses UE transform text into this value and reports whether parsing succeeded. @param SourceString UE-formatted transform text.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: FVector3f FTransform3f.InverseTransformVector(const FVector3f& V) const; | FVector3f FTransform3f.InverseTransformVectorNoScale(const FVector3f& V) const; | FQuat4f FTransform3f.TransformRotation(const FQuat4f& Q) const; | FQuat4f FTransform3f.InverseTransformRotation(const FQuat4f& Q) const; | FVector3f FTransform3f.SubtractTranslations(const FTransform3f& B) const; | void FTransform3f.NormalizeRotation(); | bool FTransform3f.TranslationEquals(const FTransform3f& Other, float32 Tolerance = __KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER_flt) const; | FRotator3f FTransform3f.Rotator() const; | void FTransform3f.ConcatenateRotation(const FQuat4f& DeltaRotation); | bool FTransform3f.InitFromString(const FString& SourceString);
